parsed.rationale: All four participating records reside under test file paths — specifically 'Shared/Playback/Tests/RadioPlayerTests/RadioPlayerControllerTests.swift', 'Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTestUtilities/Mocks/MockAudioSession.swift' (two entries), and 'Shared/PartyHorn/Tests/PartyHornTests/SoundPlayerTests.swift'. Although the context flags do not explicitly set is_test=true (likely a tagging gap in the pipeline), the file paths unambiguously place every record inside a Tests/ directory, and the dedicated Mocks/ subdirectory further confirms test-support intent. The name collision across the Playback and PartyHorn packages is therefore expected: each package defines its own local mock for isolation purposes, and consolidating them could introduce unwanted cross-package test dependencies.
